resources.string:
Thank you for using Pitch Perfect! Here\'s what has changed since you last used the app:

Version 5.1.0
- Set lists: create, rename, reorder, duplicate and delete lists of songs, copy songs between them, and switch lists from the selector above your songs.

Version 5.0.2
- Fixes a crash when choosing Sign in with Google.

Version 5.0.1
- Choose whether to share usage analytics and crash reports. Both are off until you enable them.
- Change either choice at any time in Settings.

Version 5.0.0
- A redesigned pitch pipe shows sounding notes and chords.
- Choose song keys from the key-signature list and organize your rehearsal songs.
- Sound notes from the refreshed Home Screen widget.
- Updated light and dark layouts make notes and song lists easier to read.
- Updated Wear OS support for current watches.

Version 4.0.0
-Added privacy policy
-Moves to a real-time backend for keeping your data up to date
-Adds support for more kinds of log in and account deletion
-Adds support for light/dark display modes
-Fixes a number of issues on modern versions of Android

Version 3.0.1
-Minor visual tweaks.

Version 3.0.0
-Material design overhaul.

Version 2.5.0
-Adds adaptive icon.

Version 2.4.3
-Minor bug fixes.

Version 2.4.2
-Fixes an issue with the widget font rendering.

Version 2.4.1
-Minor bug fixes.

Version 2.4.0
-You can now remove ads by subscribing using the "Tired of Ads?" link just above the ad banner.
-Corrects issues with the launcher widget.
-Fixes rendering issue on newer Android Wear devices.

Version 2.3.1
-Removes hoomi login, as the service is being discontinued.

Version 2.2.0
-A new, more material icon!

Version 2.1.2
-Fixes layout for round Android Wear devices.

Version 2.1.1
-Bug fixes.

Version 2.1.0
-New: Pitch Perfect now has a home and lock screen widget. Get a quick pitch right from the lock screen!
-Brings app, widget, and watch UIs into agreement.

Version 2.0.0
-New: Pitch Perfect has an Android Wear app! Open Pitch Perfect on your Android Wear smartwatch to remotely control Pitch Perfect on your phone! Android Wear devices don\'t have speakers, so the sound will play from your phone.

Version 1.9.10
-Improves background rendering and re-enables hardware acceleration.

Version 1.9.9
-Disables problematic hardware graphics acceleration.

Version 1.9.8
-Adds support for native Facebook login flow (see the Settings page to log in and back up your song list and preferences!)
-Minor bug fixes.

Version 1.9.7
-Minor bug fixes.

Version 1.9.6
-Minor bug fixes.
-Pitch Perfect is now available on iOS as well! Tell your friends and give it a try!

Version 1.9.5
-Minor UI tweaks.

Version 1.9.4
-Minor bug fixes.

Version 1.9.3
-Note: you can sort your list of songs using the menu button.
-Minor bug fixes.

Version 1.9.2
-Improved handling of cloud synchronization when offline.

Version 1.9.1
-Fixes a bug that kept some people from logging into the app via Facebook.
-Minor bug fixes

Version 1.9
-Log in with your Facebook ID to save your preferences and song list in the cloud! To use this feature, view the "Settings" page.
-Minor bug fixes

Version 1.8
-Allows latest native UI to be used (including Honeycomb and Ice Cream Sandwich UI features such as the action bar)
-Updates graphics to be sharp on various screen resolutions
-Makes the sort functionality for the song list more discoverable. On Honeycomb/ICS devices, an icon appears in the action bar. Older devices can access this feature using the menu key.
-Adds song deletion to the song editing activity (rather than keeping it exclusively on the song list tab)
-Minor bug fixes
